understanding: Imaginez un système qui détecte votre présence sans contact direct.

candidates.action: Red infrared waves are emitted from a human figure and travel towards the motion sensor, activating an internal component visible through the translucent casing as it lights up blue.
candidates.explains: It makes the viewer understand that infrared radiation is detected by the sensor without direct contact.
candidates.misses: Doesn't clearly show the response of the device once the motion is detected.

candidates.action: Yellow electrical signals are generated and move through the internal circuitry when the sensor detects the red infrared waves.
candidates.explains: Shows the process of detection leading to an electrical response inside the sensor.
candidates.misses: Lacks the initial detection process and only focuses on the circuitry.

candidates.action: The motion sensor's translucent casing lights up, illustrating the activation process while red and yellow pulses move within the device.
candidates.explains: Indicates activation of the sensor and the subsequent response, combining both detection and action.
candidates.misses: May not clearly specify that the initial detection is of infrared radiation from an external source.

chosen: Red infrared waves are emitted from a human figure and travel towards the motion sensor, activating an internal component visible through the translucent casing as it lights up blue.
why_chosen: This action visually conveys the cause (infrared detection) and effect (sensor activation) clearly, making it easy to understand the function of a motion sensor.

The camera is positioned to capture the sensor head-on, showing red infrared waves coming from a human figure and converging towards the sensor, which lights up in blue to indicate activation. The environment is a dark premium interior, illuminated with cinematic blue and white lighting that highlights the realistic material textures of translucent plastic and metals. The background remains subtly detailed to ensure the sensor is the main focus. animation_prompt: Starting with the human figure emitting red infrared waves, these waves move towards the motion sensor. As they reach the sensor, the internal components gradually illuminate with a blue hue, showing a pulsing effect to signal activation. The camera performs a subtle zoom-in and lateral move to emphasize the motion and response sequence, highlighting the transition from infrared detection to sensor activation.
